supplierCategory.columnHint: The product's category on the supplier's website. For Hot Bargain (200) it equals the warehouse category; product category is used by POS, warehouse category comes from HQ.
supplierCategory.manualMark: Set manually; captures won't overwrite it
supplierCategory.filterSearchEmpty: No matches. Expand a supplier to load its categories first.
supplierCategory.loadFailedRetry: Failed to load, click to retry
supplierCategory.hintUnassigned: Currently unassigned; choosing a category and saving locks it as manual
supplierCategory.hintManual: Currently set manually and not overwritten by captures; clear and save to restore automatic assignment
supplierCategory.hintWebsite: Currently auto-assigned from website captures; choosing another and saving locks it as manual
supplierCategory.hintWillLock: Saving locks this as a manual assignment that captures won't overwrite
supplierCategory.hintWillRestore: Saving restores automatic assignment from captured data
supplierCategory.batchMixedSuppliers: Selected products belong to multiple Australian suppliers, so a supplier category can't be set for all of them
supplierCategory.batchHotBargain: Hot Bargain (200) follows the warehouse category; nothing to set
supplierCategory.batchNoSupplier: Selected products have no Australian supplier
supplierCategory.batchUnknownRows: Some selected products are not on this page, so their supplier can't be determined
supplierCategory.batchSupplierChanging: Can't set a supplier category while changing the Australian supplier
supplierCategory.mismatch: The selected supplier category doesn't belong to this product's Australian supplier. Please choose again
supplierCategory.hotBargainNote: Hot Bargain (200) uses the warehouse category as its supplier category; maintain it under warehouse categories.
supplierCategory.summaryLoadFailed: Failed to load supplier category statistics
supplierCategory.selectSupplierHint: Select a supplier on the left
supplierCategory.treeEmpty: No website categories yet. Open this supplier's website with the browser extension to capture them.

supplierCategory.resolveDone: Re-resolve finished: scanned {{scanned}}, newly assigned {{assigned}}, updated {{updated}}, cleared {{cleared}}, unchanged {{unchanged}}, manual skipped {{manualSkipped}}
supplierCategory.promotionalHint: Promotional categories are excluded from automatic assignment
supplierCategory.promotionalDone: Promo flag updated: {{reassigned}} products reassigned, {{cleared}} cleared
